tools.name: screen_crypto_address
tools.description:
Screen a crypto address on any chain (or an ENS name, e.g. vitalik.eth) across the
enabled sanctions and crime lists. `lists`: optional comma-separated list slugs.

tools.name: screen_email
tools.description:
Screen an email address across the enabled sanctions and crime lists.
`lists`: optional comma-separated list slugs.

tools.name: screen_website
tools.description:
Screen a website or domain across the enabled sanctions and crime lists.
`lists`: optional comma-separated list slugs.

tools.name: screen_government_id
tools.description:
Screen a government-issued ID (passport, tax ID, …) across the enabled lists
(fuzzy matching). `lists`: optional comma-separated list slugs.

tools.name: screen_country
tools.description:
Check whether a country or region carries sanctions designations
(OFAC-curated today). `lists`: optional comma-separated list slugs.

tools.name: detect_vpn
tools.description: Detect whether an IP address is using a VPN.

tools.name: geolocate_ip
tools.description: Geolocate an IP address and flag whether it is in a sanctioned country.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: screen_email · Public sink: screen_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: screen_email · Public sink: screen_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
